product: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes
tagline: Connect to external tools (Beta): A Genie Agent can now search and take actions in external tools like Google Drive and Microsoft 365 through MCP connectors.
what_it_does: Connect to external tools (Beta): A Genie Agent can now search and take actions in external tools like Google Drive and Microsoft 365 through MCP connectors. Automatic content search on attached volumes (Beta): When you attach a volume to a Genie Agent, Databricks now automatically enables content search for it. Automatic volume sync (Beta): Content search now stays in sync with attached volumes automatically.
why_it_matters: This generates Foundation Model Serving costs (pay per token), billed under the Serverless Real time Inference SKU.
